description: For race names with above-average total points, the laps figure is the plain mean of each race name's average laps.

b.request: Calculate each race name’s total result points and compare it with the average total across race names; for names above that average, return one row with their combined total points, the unweighted mean of each name’s average laps completed, and the average amount their totals exceed the across-name average
b.sql:
WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT races.name, SUM(CAST(results.points AS REAL)) AS total_points
  FROM races
  JOIN results ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
),
across_name_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
),
above_average_names AS (
  SELECT name, total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
  WHERE total_points > (SELECT avg_total_points FROM across_name_average)
),
name_average_laps AS (
  SELECT races.name, AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM races
  JOIN results ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
)
SELECT
  SUM(above_average_names.total_points) AS combined_total_points,
  AVG(name_average_laps.avg_laps) AS mean_of_name_average_laps,
  AVG(above_average_names.total_points - across_name_average.avg_total_points) AS average_excess_points
FROM above_average_names
JOIN name_average_laps ON name_average_laps.name = above_average_names.name
CROSS JOIN across_name_average;

a.request: Matching each result to its race by `raceId`, group by race name (`races.name`) and compute each race name's total `points` and average `laps`. Keep race names whose total points are greater than the average of those totals across all race names. Return one row with: the sum of the kept race names' total points; the plain average of their per-race-name average laps, each race name counting equally; and the average amount by which their totals exceed the average total.
a.sql:
WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT ra.name, SUM(re.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(re.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM results AS re
  JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = re.raceId
  GROUP BY ra.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
)
SELECT SUM(rnt.total_points) AS sum_total_points,
       AVG(rnt.avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps,
       AVG(rnt.total_points - o.avg_total_points) AS avg_excess_points
FROM race_name_totals AS rnt
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rnt.total_points > o.avg_total_points;

c.request: Looking at race results by race name (`races.name`, matched to results by `raceId`), which race names have a total of `points` above the average total across race names? For those race names together, give me in one row their combined total points, their average laps completed, and the average amount by which their totals exceed the average total. For race names with above-average total points, the laps figure is the plain mean of each race name's average laps.
c.sql:
WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.name,
    SUM(CAST(res.points AS REAL)) AS total_points,
    AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
average_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
)
SELECT
  SUM(rnt.total_points) AS combined_total_points,
  AVG(rnt.avg_laps) AS average_laps_completed,
  AVG(rnt.total_points - at.avg_total_points) AS average_excess_points
FROM race_name_totals AS rnt
CROSS JOIN average_total AS at
WHERE rnt.total_points > at.avg_total_points;

d.request: For each race name in `races.name`, sum the `points` from matching results by `raceId`. Among race names whose total points exceed the average total across all race names, report in one row their combined total points, the plain average of their average laps completed, and the average amount by which their totals exceed the average total.
d.sql:
WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points
  FROM races r
  JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), above_average AS (
  SELECT name, total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
  WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)
), race_name_laps AS (
  SELECT r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM races r
  JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
)
SELECT SUM(a.total_points) AS combined_total_points,
       AVG(l.avg_laps) AS plain_average_avg_laps,
       AVG(a.total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)) AS avg_excess_points
FROM above_average a
JOIN race_name_laps l ON l.name = a.name;
